reason: Bound hidden external link metadata and retain readable list/link structure in long text attachments without transferring ownership to an absent attachment tray.

hiddenLink.relativeLimit: At least the greater of raw plain text and parsed visible text lengths
hiddenLink.grouping: Contiguous text with the same href and title, independent of other marks
hiddenLink.visibleHref: Case-sensitive substring inclusion removes href cost, but not title cost
hiddenLink.fallback: Available plain text, otherwise parsed visible text
hiddenLink.authoredAtomPayload: Opaque retained metadata is not external link cost

longPaste.trigger: Raw plain text has at least 5000 UTF-16 units
longPaste.normalization: Bounded HTML containing a link or list whose parsed visible text matches collapsed plain whitespace
longPaste.ownership: Only a synchronous accepting callback transfers text into an attachment; otherwise the editor consumes the paste
longPaste.messageEdit: Text remains editable and undoable; sent attachments remain fixed
longPaste.appearance: Existing attachment card appearance and layout remain unchanged

code: Use a fence longer than any backtick run in the content, with language and line indentation retained
